description: Average FPS of a graphics card (optionally with a specific CPU) at 1080p, 1440p and 4K in games measured by published benchmarks (ComputerBase, HWBen) or estimated from official requirements. Also says whether the CPU or GPU limits performance.

cpu.description: Processor slug or name; defaults to a Ryzen 7 9800X3D reference

game.description: Game slug or name from list_games; omit for all measured games

gpu.description: Graphics card slug or name, e.g. 'RTX 4060'

name: estimate_fps
title: Estimate FPS
